title: {{appName}} Preschool Series
description: The {{appName}} Preschool Series offers institutions a play-based, structured, and sustainable English education infrastructure.

hero.title: Preschool
hero.description: The {{appName}} Preschool Series offers institutions a play-based, structured, and sustainable English education infrastructure.

sections.title: The Preschool Series consists of two separate sets
sections.description: The Preschool Series consists of two separate sets: the Teacher Set and the Student Set. Discover their content through video walkthroughs. The {{appName}} Preschool system requires a minimum of 30 students in the institution. The teacher set is not sold separately. It is provided free of charge along with student sets to contracted institutions and renewed annually.

sections.title: Discover the Series Content Through Video Walkthroughs
sections.description: The Preschool Series consists of four levels: Basic, Junior, Senior, and PRO.

items.title: Basic Level
items.description: Provides a strong start to English with basic words and simple sentences.

items.title: Junior Level
items.description: Develops children's ability to build sentences and express themselves.

items.title: Senior Level
items.description: Builds the ability to use and understand English more fluently.

items.title: PRO Level
items.description: Builds a foundation in reading, writing, and academic English.

sections.title: Take a Closer Look at the System

items.title: {{appName}} Level Finder
items.description: Quickly and accurately determines the most suitable {{appName}} level by assessing the student's age, English level, and learning status. Recommends which level the student should start from based on a few short questions.

items.title: {{appName}} Library
items.description: A digital library where you can browse {{appName}} books. View all sets in detail and preview content to get a clear understanding of the system.

items.title: {{appName}} Store
items.description: An area where you can check current prices of {{appName}} sets and place online orders.

seo.title: Preschool English Learning Sets
seo.description: {{appName}} Preschool English learning set: a play-based early childhood English program for children aged 3-6. Preschool English curriculum with a Cambridge preparation system. Teacher and student sets, preschool English curriculum and lesson plans.
